title: The compact smooth bundle section topology
statement: Let $N$ be a compact Hausdorff second-countable smooth real $m$-manifold without boundary [def-sfb-smooth-real-manifold], and $B\to N$ a smooth rank-$q$ real vector bundle [def-sfb-smooth-real-vector-bundle]. On $\Gamma^\infty(B)$ [def-sfb-smooth-bundle-sections], for each smooth chart $x:U\to V\subseteq\mathbf R^m$, smooth bundle frame $e=(e_1,\ldots,e_q)$ over $U$ (a smooth fibrewise basis), compact $K\subseteq V$ and integer $k\geq0$, put $p_{x,e,K,k}(s)=\max_{|\alpha|\leq k}\sup_{z\in K}\|\partial^\alpha s_{x,e}(z)\|$, with the Euclidean norm of the coefficient vector $s_{x,e}:V\to\mathbf R^q$ defined by $s(x^{-1}(z))=\sum_{j=1}^q (s_{x,e}(z))_j e_j(x^{-1}(z))$. A multi-index is $\alpha\in\mathbf N^m$, with $|\alpha|=\sum_j\alpha_j$; $\partial^\alpha$ means repeated coordinate differentiation. Define the section topology as the smallest topology containing all translates of finite intersections of sets $\{s:p_{x,e,K,k}(s)<\epsilon\}$, for $\epsilon>0$, using all these charts and frames. The translate by $s_0$ of a set $A$ means $s_0+A=\{s_0+t:t\in A\}$. Put $\Gamma_c^\infty(B)=\{s\in\Gamma^\infty(B):\operatorname{supp}(s)\text{ is compact}\}$, with $\operatorname{supp}(s)=\overline{\{x:s(x)\ne0\}}$, and give it the subspace topology. Empty compact suprema and norms in rank zero are $0$; when $m=0$ the unique multi-index has order zero and $\partial^0s_{x,e}=s_{x,e}$.
